name: crewglass
description: See, design and safeguard your Claude Code agent team — a local-only macOS app.

scripts.build:hook: mkdir -p out/bin && swiftc -O hook/main.swift -o out/bin/crewglass-hook && cp resources/agy-bridge/agy-bridge.mjs out/bin/agy-bridge.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:network && node scripts/check-audit.mjs
scripts.dmg: CREWGLASS_SHARE=1 npm run dist && node scripts/make-dmg.mjs

author: Shirish-012
